We didn't think Coruscant would be interested in our little break-in.|Cord Taunus|}} '''Cord Taunus''' was a [[human]] [[Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]] who administered the [[Olega Jedi temple|Jedi temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. In [[132 BBY]], he searched the [[Jedi temple|temple]] after the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Skirmish on Olega|broke in]] and [[Mae's quest|attempted]] to [[Death|kill]] Jedi Master [[Torbin]], but was unable to find her. The next [[Standard day|day]], he met with Jedi Master [[Sol]], [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]], and Mae-ho's [[twin]] [[Aniseya family|sister]] [[Verosha Aniseya]] and spoke to them about the break-in. After Sol asked to speak with Torbin, Taunus led the group to his quarters, but when they arrived, they found Verosha next to Torbin's dead body. The Jedi Master drew his [[lightsaber]], but he complied with Sol's gesture to lower it after Fandar confirmed Verosha's innocence. Sol then determined that Torbin had killed himself. ==Biography== ===Steward of Olega=== {{Quote|Someone spotted a hooded intruder and alerted me, but we searched the temple and found nothing.|Cord Taunus|}} [[File:OlegaMasterPadawanUrchin-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|right|300px|Cord Taunus meets with Sol's team.]] Cord Taunus was a [[human]] [[Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order]] who administered the [[Olega Jedi temple|Jedi temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. Among his duties as the [[Steward (occupation)|Steward]] of Olega was monitoring Jedi Master [[Torbin]], who, around [[142 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} "[[Revenge / Justice]]" establishes that [[Torbin]] took the [[Barash Vow]] over ten [[Standard year|years]] before its events, equating to around [[142 BBY]]. took the [[Barash Vow]], entering a state of deep [[meditation]] and self-imposed isolation. In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} the [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Skirmish on Olega|broke into]] the [[Jedi temple|temple]] and [[Mae's quest|attempted]] to [[Death|kill]] Torbin, who remained in his state of meditation. An individual saw the intruder and alerted Taunus, who yelled to search the temple. After hearing his alert, Aniseya fled just before Taunus entered Torbin's quarters. After briefly looking around and finding the room empty except for Torbin, Taunus left. The next [[Standard day|day]], Jedi Master [[Sol]], [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]], [[Jedi Knight]] [[Yord Fandar]], and Mae-ho's [[twin]] [[Aniseya family|sister]] [[Verosha Aniseya]] arrived at the Olega temple to investigate. Taunus welcomed them and was surprised that they were interested in the break-in, prompting Sol to explain they believed it was connected to another investigation, the [[Indara's murder|murder]] of Jedi Master [[Indara]]. Fandar asked Taunus to explain what had happened the previous [[Local day|night]], and as he did, Padawan [[Od Keder]] brought out the urchin [[Guthan Archi]], whom he said had been caught messing around the temple's portcullis before its [[TT-8L/Y7 gatekeeper droid|gatekeeper droids]] failed. Lon then knelt and spoke with Archi, who confirmed he had been paid to activate the [[TT-8L-OT|security droid]], though he misidentified Verosha as the individual who had paid him. Sol then asked to speak with Torbin, and although Taunus responded that he had not spoken in over ten years, Sol claimed Torbin would speak to him, as he was an old friend. ===Murder of a master=== {{Quote|Hey! Step away from the body.''"
"''I know what this looks like, but I can explain.''"
"''Do not move.|Cord Taunus and Verosha Aniseya|}} [[File:OlegaMasterLightsaber-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|325px|Cord Taunus aims his lightsaber at Verosha Aniseya.]] Taunus led the others through the temple towards Torbin's quarters, with Verosha separating from the group. As they walked, Mae-ho returned and offered [[Bunta|poison]] to Torbin, who willingly drank it to atone for his role in an [[Mission to Brendok|incident]] that had occurred [[148 BBY|sixteen years]] prior. Following Torbin's death, Mae-ho escaped the temple and Verosha arrived in the room ahead of the rest of the group, where she found Torbin's body. Soon after, Taunus arrived with the rest of the Jedi, rushing into the room and igniting his [[lightsaber]] while commanding Verosha to step away from Torbin's body. Taunus demanded Verosha explain herself, but Fandar, who had followed her after she separated from the group, was able to confirm her innocence. Sol gestured to Taunus, and he lowered his lightsaber and powered it off. While examining Torbin's body, Lon noted there were no signs of struggle, and Sol realized that Torbin had taken the poison willingly, prompting Taunus to wonder why Torbin had killed himself. Verosha identified the [[poison]] as bunta, and the other Jedi continued the investigation at a nearby [[Olega Apothecary|apothecary]]. ==Personality and traits== Cord Taunus had [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, light skin, and graying brown [[hair]] and a beard. He was surprised by Sol's visit and found it unthinkable that someone would find Torbin to be a threat. Taunus was suspicious of Verosha Aniseya after finding her with Torbin's body and pointed his lightsaber at her, but lowered it when Sol gestured for him to do so. ==Powers and abilities== As a member of the Jedi Order, Cord Taunus was [[Force-sensitive]] and trained to [[Force power|wield]] [[the Force]]. ==Equipment== Cord Taunus wore brown [[Jedi apparel]] with a sleeveless quilted [[Clothing|tabard]] and [[Synthleather|synth-leather]] [[boot]]s. He wielded a blue-bladed lightsaber that he owned since his apprenticeship. His lightsaber had a [[hilt-ring]], which was becoming increasingly common by 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:OutpostJediCostumeConcept-ArtOfAcolyte.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Eleanor Barlow]] Cord Taunus first appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]]," the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte|The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} Prior to the episode's release, he was first depicted in a video uploaded to the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' Australia & New Zealand [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel on [[May 14]] of that year.{{YouTube|channel=@StarWarsAUNZ|name=''Star Wars'' Australia & New Zealand|video=ksgTjH1JoHk|text=Lee Jung-jae | The Acolyte}} Taunus was identified in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''. He was portrayed by [[Nick Court]]. The scenes on Olega''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' that included Taunus were shot at the back lot of [[Shinfield Studios]] in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]]. For the show's original characters,{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@RottenTomatoesTV|name=Rotten Tomatoes|link=Wikipedia:Rotten Tomatoes|video=hkJos35CuV0|text='The Acolyte' Cast on New Lightsabers and
